environment.description: Deployed on a GKE cluster (1.27) as a ClusterIP service behind an nginx ingress controller (ingress-nginx 1.9.4) with default configuration. The ingress resource routes /api/v1/* to the Flask service on port 8080. No additional middleware or request filtering is configured. The SQLite database is mounted from a persistent volume. Network policy allows ingress from the nginx controller pod to the Flask pod on port 8080.
